individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: This college is the worst option for any student.

content.Placements: I heard from many of my seniors that there are no placements at all. Only 1 out of 250 students got placed. Students got placements with a minimum salary that ranges from Rs. 10,000-15,000 per month. The placement companies are not MNCs, and they're like small corporations, etc. I saw a pass-out student got a placement in a petrol pump.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are clean, but there is only one Wi-Fi on each floor, which doesn't even work properly sometimes. In labs, PCs are too old, and we practice coding in Turbo and C++. This app was used in the 19th century, and they used to study on whiteboards, which are not visible from the blackboard.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is average to take admission in this college. There is an average type of placement too.

content.Placements: There are above 100+ students who get admission, and they take their classes or lectures on time and conduct regular exams. Flipkart and Amazon provide internships or placements. In our college, 20 percent of students got their placements in these companies.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, we have a nice library, where we get every type of book and novel except our own subject books. Our college also has an average canteen. Sometimes the food in the canteen is nice, but other times, after we eat, we feel ill.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: St. Wilfred College is good for a career. The facilities on the campus are really very good.

content.Placements: The minimum percentage required to get placed in my college is 50%. The highest package in my college is 12 LPA, and the minimum package is 4 LPA. The placement and internship companies in my college include Wipro, SBI, Infosys, Myntra, Nykaa, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: The college facilities and infrastructure are very good. For example, the college campus has computer labs, a biology lab, a chemistry lab, and very clean and spacious classrooms. The library also provides a very good and decent environment. The sports facilities are also good. The hostel facilities are good, the food is hygienic and tasty, and the college provides medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: In my suggestion, do not take admission to this college.

content.Placements: This college is not that good in placements. I am in the first year now, so I talked about this with some of my seniors. They said that the percentage of students getting placements is about 20%, but I don't know about the companies. I know that Tata Steel and some others recruit here.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very bad; in fact, it is very congested. According to the fees they are taking, it's not worth that much money. In fact, if you are planning to take admission because of sports, this is not the college for you; they don't have their own ground where students can play.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Overall, absolutely satisfied.

content.Placements: In St. Wilfred PG College, there are many UG and PG courses like B.A., BCA, B.Sc., M.A., M.B.A., MCA, M.Sc., and more. I am pursuing BCA at Wilfred College. There is a good ratio of boys and girls. I am in the 2024-2025 batch, in my first year. There were many pass-outs with good placements.
content.Infrastructure: Cleanliness and a productive environment are their first priorities. There are smart boards in every classroom with a high-speed Wi-Fi connection. There is a big library open until 4 pm, with 2 reading rooms for the students. Wilfred College doesn't provide hostel facilities, but there are many PGs and hostels nearby.

reviews.review_text:

reviews.review_heading: St. Wilfreds PG College is the best for BCA in Jaipur.

reviews.review_heading: My college is the best for what I choose.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure, faculty members, placements, and all other things in college are below average.

content.Placements: I don't think anybody in our batch gets placed except for 2-3 students. The average package ranges from 2-3 LPA. Very few companies came for placements that too are less known like uBuddy. Around 60% of students got internships from our course in NGO-based and sales companies and that too poorly.
content.Infrastructure: Overall, the infrastructure of the college is below average and not very good. There is no Wi-Fi facility. The library does not have informative books and only has course-related books. There is no hostel facility and the canteen is just average with normal food quality and not any difference in it. It gives false claims of providing sports and games. It only has volleyball, cricket, and chess, and that too they don't provide it.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018

content.Infrastructure: In Vikrant Institute of Technology and Management, there was good infrastructure and well-maintained classrooms was available. Wi-Fi was available, labs were well-maintained,and also in our courseWorkshops were also available for practicals and practice. A well-maintained library was also available.

individual_reviews.title: An honest review of Vikrant group of institutions.

admission_process.title: CT Group of Institutions, North Campus Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: CT Group of Institutions admissionsare primarily merit-based. The institution offers courses at UG and PG levels through CT Institute of Technology and Research, CT Institute of Management & IT and CT College of Education.CT Group of Institutions (North Campus)offers courses in multiple streams through the institutes under it. Candidates can apply online on the official website of the institution for admission.

Candidates can apply for UG courses at CT Group after completing Class 12. The minimum eligibility for PG programmes is graduation. Aspirants must meet the eligibility requirement specific to their course for admission. Below is the eligibility and selection criteria for topCT Group of Institutions courses:

Class 12 with Commerce stream with at least 33% aggregate (40% aggregate for the students who have opted for 2 of the following subject in Class 12 Accountancy/ Business Studies/Economics/Math/ Office Mgt And Secretarial Practice/ Principal And Practice Of Insurance/ Tax Processor & Practice
For all other candidates, the minimum required aggregate is 45%

CT Group of Institutions fee varies course-wise. Candidates who are selected are required to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the institute. Find below theCT Group of Institutions feeand seat intake:
INR 1.3 lakh
INR 1.2 lakh
INR 1.2 lakh
Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

CT Group of Institutions admission start with registration for the preferred course. The institute evaluates the candidate's performance for admission. Follow the below steps to get a seat in CT Group of Institutions:
STEP 1: CT Group of Institutions (North Campus) Application Process 2025

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online on the official website of the institute. Aspirants are required to pay an application fee and submit the specified documents along with the form.
STEP 2: Selection

Once the candidates fill out the application form, their score and qualification is considered for admission. The institutes evaluate the applications of the candidates for admission to most of the UG and PG courses.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation & Fee Payment
Selected candidates further receive an admission letter confirming their selection. Such aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

reviews.review_heading: The beautiful infrastructure with greenery and teaching style is excellent.

We have a bedroom and housekeeping lab for housekeeping practical, 4 kitchens for food production, 2 restaurants for food and beverages, reception and lobby area for the front office. Quality of the hostel is good, and the mess is always clean and serves food.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and other facilities were not up to the mark but the faculty was good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was just about okay. The quality of the food is not so good and the hostel rooms are average. reviews.review_heading: If you want to join here only for study, then I suggest you join.

Facilities in the hostel are pretty disgusting because the quality of the food is very low like D grade. The mess is a little bit dirty sometimes.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my college because of good education and atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: There are IT labs, FCPIT lab, Software lab, Haryana lab, Web development lab, tom lab, AutoCad lab, etc. Quality is awesome. In canteens, every type of food item is available. individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely, the college is good. Classrooms are also good.

content.Placements: The percentage of students who got placed in the BCA course is above 70 percent. The lowest package offered is 10 LPA. Many companies like Wipro, etc., hire students from the college. The percentage of students who got internships from BCA is 70 to 80 percent in companies like Wipro, Adani, etc. The top roles offered are in the IT sector, data analysis, web development, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good for all types of courses. All facilities are available, like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library. Quality and facilities are good in hostels. The quality of the food is also good. Sports and games are provided. I do not know if medical facilities are available or not.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons) Psychology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with their approach.

content.Placements: The course needed higher studies, so placements were not given, but the higher studies options were given. College also provided post-graduation. The college also provided internship opportunities, and this was compulsory for the completion of the course.
content.Infrastructure: Very good infrastructure, the department provided good faculty members, a department library, a common library, and a good practical laboratory. Wi-Fi was available, but not for students. Classrooms were good and had proper facilities. The canteen was small, with only snacks, but good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is very poor. I never thought that I was living college life.

content.Placements: Only 40-50% of students are only placed. The average package ranges from 3-4 LPA. The lowest package ranges from 4-5 LPA. The highest package is 12 LPA, and the lowest package is 1.2 LPA. Companies like Wipro, Infosys, and HCL visit the college to hire students. Approximately 50-60% of students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: Library and computer labs are provided for students. However, it is not very effective for students because they never clean the library and computers. We can see rats roaming there. It provides 2-3 fans in a big hall classes, which cause so much humidity and heat in the room.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: This college is the best.

content.Placements: 85 percent of our students are placed in the top departments. Among the best employers are Dell Technologies, Hewlett-Packard, and HCL Technologies. 20 LPA is the highest compensation. The average salary is 6 LPA, with a minimum of 3.5 LPA. Students must look for off-campus jobs in order to obtain internships but colleges supply all the information they need. Computer programs and software development are among the most popular positions that recruiters offer at universities.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the hostel is good. The amenities offered are quite wonderful if we stay at the college dorms. There are conveniences like hot water and Wi-Fi. The rooms are excellent. Students enrolled in the same subject are housed in the same room. Every month, the dormitory warden and parents have a conversation.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: This college is the best for placements.

content.Placements: 85 percent of placement opportunities are provided. The maximum salary offered for household goods is 15 LPA. The lowest salary offered by a startup is 3 LPA. The average salary package is approximately 5.5 LPA. Leading companies that visit the college are NTPC, Karur Vysya Bank, and L&T Finance. Cloud architect and software developer are prominent roles offered to students. 70 percent of students are able to secure internships.
content.Infrastructure: Labs and lecture halls are excellent and have good ventilation. There are cozy chairs and tables throughout the hotel. reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: My honest review of my college.

review_content.Placements: Placements are improving day by day. Various companies, like start-ups and multinationals, come to the campus for drives in the college. College even has a separate placement cell, which is purely focused on employment and placing students in different companies. This cell is doing great day by day and brings various companies to campus.
review_content.Infrastructure: I am actually the president here, so I have no idea about the fees of hostels and seats. Various PG rooms are available, which are within 5-10 minutes' walking distance of the college. I am a tech geek and I like to work on computers or design. After searching for a while, I found that it's more suitable for me to study in a government college due to my financial condition. It taught us well what was in our syllabus, and I think there are smart classrooms that should add a plus point in the college course about computer applications.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Point of view towards Zeal.

review_content.Placements: Nearly 37% of students get placed, and others get internships. The highest package was 12 LPA, and the lowest is 1.9 LPA. TCS, Accenture, Jade Global, Hexaware, and Deloitte are some of the top recruiters. Nearly 87% of students get internships through college. Software engineer, software developer, Jira developer, etc. are the top roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: For MCA and MBA, there is a separate building called ZIBACAR, which has four floors. For MCA, there are two classrooms for the first year and a separate library too. We have 5+ computer labs present in the building. College provides free Wi-Fi also. I am not living in a hostel, but it will also be good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the placements and faculty.

review_content.Placements: College placements are good improving day by day. Many startups and multi national companies have tie ups with the college. College has a separate team that fully focuses on placing students in good companies. Infosys, IBM, Deloitte, Infomatics, TCS etc. arrange placement drives. Packages depend upon the company offering. Infosys offered packages in the range of 3.6 to 10 LPA, while TCS offered packagers worth 3.8 to 12 LPA. They differed for all the companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: College facilities are the best. The infrastructure is really attractive. The college’s fest name is "udaan" and the sports fest is named "Raanangan" which are celebrated on a mass level. The fest has traditional day, dance, and DJ night being arranged for the students. College provides facilities including Wi-Fi, WLAN, and good labs. The computer labs are kept really clean. The library has all the kind of books. Separate hostels are provided for girls and boys having laundry, mess and washing facilities. Mess provides non veg twice a week. Also many PGs are available at a walking distance of 5-10 min from the campus.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Grow yourself with zeal at this college.

review_content.Placements: Placement percentage for students is 70–80%, the highest package is INR 8–10 LPA, and the average package is INR 3-5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Jio, Reliance, Bajaj, Shriram, Trident, etc. The roles offered are management trainer, finance associate, etc. 60% of students in the final semester got paid internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities at the college are the best, like free Wi-Fi, sports assistance, a virtual library, etc. The facilities of the hostel include a gym, morning meals, and coffee. The quality of the hostel food is not very good, but we can say it is decent. There are two canteens in the college that have good food.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: Our college's faculty members and placements are good.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are very good. Our college has an active training and placement cell for students. Already many students got placed in many core companies, and many companies visit our college for placements and hire many students.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college is good for girls. Facilities and infrastructure are the best for our college. Labs, classrooms and the library are also the best. The food available in the mess and canteen is good. The college is good, and the infrastructure for the course and hostel is also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: 100% of the students were placed in various on and off-campus drives.

review_content.Placements: In the institute placement of students is extremely well other than the rest of the institute in Pune. 100% of students were placed in various on and off-campus drives organized by the institute with a package between 3 lacs and 7 lacs.
review_content.Infrastructure: The zeal campus has an outstanding infrastructure with all the modern facilities, conducive for academics and extra curricular activities which help for learning and personal development of the every students who admitted in zeal. A campus facility include auditorium, gym, dance and music studio abd sports ground for cricket, basketball, volleyball and football etc.

content.Infrastructure: The canteen is good, and Wi-Fi is available. There is a big playground and a large seminar hall. One exception is that you can visit the college at any time. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and facilities and also helpful and qualified teachers.

content.Placements: Our college has been providing placements in good companies from the last 3 years as our seniors told us about that. In our batch, placements are not being provided because of the COVID-19 pandemic. Students got admission to our college based on their JEE exam rank. You will also get a direct admission if you have 65% of marks in your 12th standard.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides facilities like good condition classrooms, library, canteen, medical facilities and also sports and games. The food provided in the canteen is good. The library provides all books for every course. Classrooms and labs are air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi is provided for college work.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure and placements of the college are dissatisfying, but the faculty members are good.

content.Placements: A very few opportunities are available for being selected in any campus placements. Only a few companies visit our college. I have been in this college for three years, and I have never seen any official placements. But I have heard from our seniors that the college provides a few placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is decent. The cafeteria is well-equipped, but the library is not up to the mark. The campus is pretty decent, and the classrooms are pretty good. The campus is lush green and eco-friendly. Parking facility in the college is great and promising. A hostel was available, but now it is abandoned due to some reasons.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: A review about LGC and the commitments made by them during admissions.

content.Placements: LGC is a college that promise placements during admissions. But in reality, they never placed any student from their college. Even they also conduct few mock exams to create fake placement interview. This is to get the publicity that we have placed a lot of students. But in 2016 batch not a single student was placed from LGC.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, and even labs are well equipped. Branded computer systems are installed in the labs, and the networking staff well maintains the labs and even mechanical workshops also good. Lack of games and sports in LGC because they don't promote students in games, and they also don't have a proper ground.

reviews.review_heading: It has nice facilities and good infrastructure. It has 2 campuses and is good to take admission.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a study environment and daily classes. It has a nice campus and also a playground. The library has books for every course. A hostel facility is also available with good food. There are helpful colleagues who help us in our studies and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: Our batch of integrated BBA+MBA students had a great journey despite having a small class size.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is not up to par but they have recently renovated the digital room with the latest digital equipment for the management students. The hostel facilities are designed to offer a comfortable and conducive living environment for students.

reviews.review_heading: Realistic review of Mahatma jyotirao phoole university.
reviews.review_text: The college has many labs, like the psychology lab, the physics lab, the chemistry lab, the botany lab, and the and the Zoology lab, and each and every course student has their own classroom. There is no Wi-Fi facility available. There is a very good, spacious library with every book that you need.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of no placements and Scholarships. The faculty and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: It has a separate building, and there are many students in the department. The hostel facility is very good. I have been staying in the hostel for almost 2 years and I really enjoyed it. The Hostel is well maintained, and the rooms are very spacious. There are also other facilities like Libraries and Labs for the students. But there is no Canteen available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college campus review.
reviews.review_text: As a student of this University, I am interested in Computer Science whose faculty teaches very clearly and gives us proper knowledge of the course which is very good. We have an unlimited Wi-Fi, 2 computer labs, a library and a hostel for girls.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend joining this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college provides us with all facilities. The campus is fully connected to high-speed Wi-Fi. Classrooms and labs are excellent. The food served in the mess is good. They provide games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college has very nice infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities available in the course and hostel at the college. Wi-fi, lab, classroom, library—all the necessary facilities are available in the college. The quality of the facilities is decent. Mess and canteen food are acceptable. There are sports facilities, and the number of medical facilities is also high.

reviews.review_heading: The worst decision of my life is, joining this college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, and labs are not available. Computers do not work properly. Toilets are not maintained properly. Dissatisfied with the college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides the best knowledge to students.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides internships in the final year. The average salary offered is Rs. 54,000 per month.

reviews.review_heading: The college is absolutely not good for law students.
reviews.review_text: The library is not updated for a very long time. Books are too old and not a sufficient collection of books are there. The classrooms are average. You should not expect smart classrooms here. Wi-Fi is not good. There is no canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is the best for physiotherapy.
reviews.review_text: There are many hostels in our college. There are separate hostels for girls and boys.  Wi-Fi is available for students to study. There are many cultural activities and events. There is a library for students to study there.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college. I suggest you take admission here to make your career.
reviews.review_text: It has excellent Wi-Fi speed, good labs, and well-seated classrooms. The library environment is very good, and it has knowledgeable books. The hostel quality is good. The food served is just like home food. There is also a huge canteen in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Mahatma Jyoti Rao Phoole University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, well-equipped with ventilation and Wi-Fi. The food is decent. The variety in food is good, and they give you three meals a day and tea two times a day. The hostel fee is affordable, even the hostel facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a bit above average college.
reviews.review_text: There is no boys hostel on the main city campus. There is no Wi-Fi in college. There is no ground on the main city campus. It has PGs around it, so you can live nearby with freedom.

reviews.review_heading: This university is good but not for every course.
reviews.review_text: This college has a small campus, but the way they have utilised that small space is good. Hostels still do not have a washroom on one floor, but it will be built in a couple of years. There is no canteen and no sports and games in this college. The food served in a hostel is very good.
